title: Two days to prepare.
lines: Back up your files, confirm your bookings, read the fine print.
Mercury turns retrograde in Scorpio on Saturday.
caption:

title: Mercury stations retrograde
lines: At 20°58' Scorpio, Mercury seems to stop, then reverse.
caption:
Mercury stations retrograde tonight at 20°58' Scorpio (Oct 24, 06:50 UTC; 2:50am ET). ☿

A station is when a planet seems to stand still against the stars before it changes direction. It is Earth's own motion: Mercury, the faster planet, is passing between us and the Sun, like a car overtaking another and making it look as if it slides backward.

Mercury does this 3 or 4 times a year, for about three weeks. This one runs Oct 24 → Nov 13 (5°02' Scorpio). In Vedic astrology this station falls in the star Vishakha.

title: Evening star to morning star
lines: On Oct 24 Venus passed the Sun at 0°44' Scorpio; on Oct 25 she re-entered Libra at 29°.
caption:
Venus is retrograde, and this weekend she changed sides of the Sun. 💫

◆ Oct 24, 03:40 UTC: Venus passes the Sun at 0°44' Scorpio and becomes a morning star
◆ Oct 25: she slipped back into Libra, her own sign, at 29°
◆ Nov 14: she turns direct at 22°51' Libra

The oldest versions of the story: Sumerians told of Inanna descending to the underworld and returning, and Babylonian astronomers recorded Venus's disappearances and returns on clay tablets.

Venus retrogrades about every 19 months, for about 40 days, and tends to bring up love, money and values for a second look. Ask the Oracle which house of your chart Libra falls in: link in bio.

title: Full Moon, then Sun square Pluto
lines: Exact 04:12 UTC Oct 26 (12:12am ET). At 12:20 UTC the Sun squares Pluto at 3° Scorpio/Aquarius.
caption:
Full Moon at 2°46' Taurus tonight: exact Oct 26 at 04:12 UTC (9:12pm PT, 12:12am ET). 🌕

The Moon is exalted in Taurus: traditional astrology puts its strongest degree at exactly 3°. In Vedic astrology this Moon sits in the star Ashwini, the healer.

Then at 12:20 UTC the Sun at 3°08' Scorpio squares Pluto at 3°05' Aquarius: two fixed signs, control against release.

title: Three phases of a retrograde
lines: Retrograde Oct 24 – Nov 13; the shadow ends Nov 30.
caption:
A retrograde has three phases. ☿

◆ Pre-shadow: Mercury crosses the degrees it revisits later
◆ Retrograde: Oct 24 at 20°58' Scorpio → Nov 13 at 5°02' Scorpio
◆ Post-shadow: it re-crosses 21° Scorpio on Nov 30

That is why a retrograde matters beyond its dates: what is reviewed now tends to settle by Nov 30.

title: Venus draws a pentagram
lines: Over 8 years, Venus's five retrogrades trace a five-pointed star.
caption:
Venus draws a pentagram in the sky. 💫

Every 8 years Venus makes 5 retrogrades. Plot where each one happens against the zodiac and the five points form a perfect five-petal star, a pattern ancient astronomers noticed.

This retrograde is at 27° Libra on Oct 29 and turns direct on Nov 14 at 22°51' Libra.

title: What a square means
lines: A square is 90°: two planets in tension that ask for action.
caption:
What does a square mean in astrology? ⚡

A square is two planets 90° apart. Their signs share a mode but not an element, so they pull in different directions and ask for action rather than ease.

Today's example: Mercury (retrograde) at 17°53' Scorpio squares Mars at 18°01' Leo, exact at 17:30 UTC. Both signs are fixed, so the argument tends to dig in.

title: The real midpoint of autumn
lines: The Sun reaches 15° Scorpio on Nov 7, halfway from equinox to solstice.
caption:
Halloween marks the old festival of Samhain, the midpoint of autumn. 🎃

In the sky, that exact midpoint comes a week later: the Sun reaches 15° Scorpio on Nov 7 (10:00 UTC), halfway between the September equinox and the December solstice. The old calendars used Oct 31 as a round date for it.

Scorpio is a fixed sign, and 15° is its heart. Mercury is retrograde there until Nov 13 (direct at 5°02' Scorpio).
